rationale: C14 supplies essentially the complete two-part drafting structure of the child: the operative designation granting privileges under the International Organizations Immunities Act, followed by the distinctive proviso that designation is not intended to abridge privileges acquired or later acquired by treaty or congressional action. The child adapts this template from one organization to three. C07 and C02 contain the same machinery and highly similar language, but C14 is the closest match in wording, structure, and temporal proximity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the Preparatory Commission of the International Atomic Energy Agency, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and the Universal Postal Union as public international organizations entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the operative designation sentence almost verbatim, changing the named organization and adjusting singular to plural.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the Preparatory Commission of the International Atomic Energy Agency, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and the Universal Postal Union as public international organizations within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organizations may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive savings clause is copied nearly word for word, with only the organization names and number agreement changed.
